items.informal_name: Evaluation of Polynomial Remainder Equals Original at Root of Monic Divisor
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {S : Type v} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : CommRing S] {f : R →+* S} {p q : Polynomial R},
  q.Monic → ∀ {x : S}, Polynomial.eval₂ f x q = 0 → Polynomial.eval₂ f x (p %ₘ q) = Polynomial.eval₂ f x p
items.informal_description: Let $ R $ and $ S $ be commutative rings, $ f : R \to S $ a ring homomorphism, and $ q \in R[X] $ a monic polynomial. If $ x \in S $ satisfies $ q(x) = 0 $, then for any polynomial $ p \in R[X] $, the evaluation of the remainder $ p \bmod q $ at $ x $ equals the evaluation of $ p $ at $ x $, i.e., $ (p \bmod q)(x) = p(x) $.

items.informal_name: Evaluation of Polynomial Remainder Equals Original at Root of Monic Divisor
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {S : Type v} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : Ring S] [inst_2 : Algebra R S] {p q : Polynomial R},
  q.Monic → ∀ {x : S}, (Polynomial.aeval x) q = 0 → (Polynomial.aeval x) (p %ₘ q) = (Polynomial.aeval x) p
items.informal_description: For any polynomials $ p $ and monic $ q $ over a semiring $ R $, and for any element $ x $ in an $ R $-algebra $ S $ such that $ q(x) = 0 $, the evaluation of the remainder $ p \bmod q $ at $ x $ equals the evaluation of $ p $ at $ x $, i.e., $ \operatorname{aeval}_x (p \bmod q) = \operatorname{aeval}_x p $.

items.informal_name: Remainder Equality for Monic Polynomial Division under Divisibility of the Difference
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] {p₁ p₂ q : Polynomial R}, q.Monic → q ∣ p₁ - p₂ → p₁ %ₘ q = p₂ %ₘ q
items.informal_description: If $ q $ is a monic polynomial and $ q $ divides $ p_1 - p_2 $, then the remainder of $ p_1 $ divided by $ q $ is equal to the remainder of $ p_2 $ divided by $ q $.

items.informal_name: Evaluation Homomorphism Respects Polynomial Division by Monic Polynomial
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {S : Type v} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : Ring S] {f : Polynomial R} [inst_2 : Algebra R S]
  (h : IsAdjoinRootMonic S f) (g : Polynomial R), h.map (g %ₘ f) = h.map g
items.informal_description: For any polynomial $ g \in R[X] $, the evaluation homomorphism $ h $ satisfies $ h(g) = h(r) $, where $ r $ denotes the remainder of dividing $ g $ by the monic polynomial $ f $. This equality demonstrates that $ h $ factors through the quotient ring $ R[X]/(f) $, as the image of $ g $ under $ h $ depends only on its equivalence class modulo $ f $.

items.informal_name: Ring Homomorphism Preserves Polynomial Remainder under Monic Division
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {S : Type v} [inst : Ring R] {p q : Polynomial R} [inst_1 : Ring S] (f : R →+* S),
  q.Monic → Polynomial.map f (p %ₘ q) = Polynomial.map f p %ₘ Polynomial.map f q
items.informal_description: For any ring homomorphism $ f : R \to S $ and monic polynomial $ q \in R[X] $, the image of the remainder $ p \mod q $ under $ f $ is equal to the remainder of $ f(p) \mod f(q) $, i.e., $ f(p \mod q) = f(p) \mod f(q) $.

items.informal_name: Compatibility of Polynomial Coefficient Mapping with Division and Modulus by Monic Polynomials
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {S : Type v} [inst : Ring R] {p q : Polynomial R} [inst_1 : Ring S] (f : R →+* S),
  q.Monic →
    Polynomial.map f (p /ₘ q) = Polynomial.map f p /ₘ Polynomial.map f q ∧
      Polynomial.map f (p %ₘ q) = Polynomial.map f p %ₘ Polynomial.map f q
items.informal_description: For any ring homomorphism $ f : R \to S $ and monic polynomial $ q \in R[X] $, the quotient and remainder of dividing a polynomial $ p $ by $ q $ are preserved under coefficient mapping via $ f $. Specifically, $ (p /_\mathrm{monic} q).\mathrm{map}(f) = p.\mathrm{map}(f) /_\mathrm{monic} q.\mathrm{map}(f) $ and $ (p \%_\mathrm{monic} q).\mathrm{map}(f) = p.\mathrm{map}(f) \%_\mathrm{monic} q.\mathrm{map}(f) $.
